reason: The README describes an installable dsh bundle centered on discovering, inspecting, approving, and installing community plugins, with GitHub-backed search and a marketplace-style UI tab.

summaries.zh: 这是一个用于搜索、查看、核验并在确认后安装 DeepSeek Harness 社区插件的 dsh 插件聚合工具。
summaries.en: A dsh plugin hub for searching, inspecting, verifying, and installing community DeepSeek Harness plugins after user confirmation.

capabilities: Searches and refreshes a registry of community dsh plugins using embedded data and optional GitHub search
Retrieves plugin repository details and performs installation checks
Installs selected plugins by executing dsh plugin add after Web UI approval or explicit confirmation
Adds a plugin marketplace tab to the dsh session interface
